lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Hello again! It is me, Tilly. Today my story is about <color=red>space</color>.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Listen to my story. Then I will ask you four questions. Get them right and the library gets four new <color=red>books</color>!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Zara has a little <color=red>rocket</color>. It is silver and blue.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Zara flies up past the clouds. She sees lots of shiny <color=red>stars</color>.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: She lands on the Moon. She finds a small, grey <color=red>rock</color>.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Zara flies home. She gives the rock to her <color=red>grandad</color>. He smiles.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 1: What colour is Zara's rocket?
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about the start of the story!
lines.correctText: Yes! It is silver and blue.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 2: What does Zara see past the clouds?
lines.hint: Not quite. What is shiny in the sky?
lines.correctText: That is right! She sees shiny stars.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.hint: Not quite. Where does she find the rock?
lines.correctText: Well done! She lands on the Moon.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about the end of the story!
lines.correctText: Yes! Her grandad gets the rock.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Four out of four! You are a <color=red>star</color> reader. The library has four new books!

afterLines.speaker: Tilly
afterLines.text: Thank you for listening! Go and look at the new <color=red>books</color> in the library.
